name: documint
description: Source-grounded codebase documentation workflows for ChatGPT and Codex, without a dedicated server.

interface.longDescription: Explain files, build evidence-backed project maps, and prepare Markdown documentation using the source you provide or can access with existing tools. No DocuMint server required.
defaultPrompt: Use DocuMint to document this codebase from the files I provide.
Create a source-grounded architecture map and reading path for this repository.
Explain this source file, including exports, imports and important behavior.
